title: GEX Screener Paper-Collage Tutorial
creativeAngle: A paper pinball table makes invisible dealer pressure visible, then folds into TradingFlow's Rank Symbols map.

scenes.idea: Price can pin until it suddenly breaks.
scenes.action: A paper price puck taps the call wall, bounces from the put wall, then tears through the ceiling.
scenes.joke: A tiny trader is left staring at the torn bumper.
scenes.narration: Price taps the same ceiling. Again. Again. Then one day, it flies through.

scenes.idea: Dealer hedging can resist or reinforce a move.
scenes.action: The table splits into positive and negative GEX; paper hands push against or with the puck.
scenes.joke: The positive side uses a cushion; the negative side needs a seat belt.
scenes.narration: The difference can be pressure you can't see.
labels: POSITIVE GEX — hedge against the move
NEGATIVE GEX — hedge with the move

scenes.idea: Use Rank Symbols to inspect the regime.
scenes.action: The pinball table folds into the current Rank Symbols UI and highlights three steps.
scenes.joke: The last paper tab lands with a precise little stamp.
scenes.narration: Start with the market's mood, not a prediction.

scenes.idea: Read regime, zero gamma, and walls while respecting the data horizon.
scenes.action: The drawer unfolds into four cards; a separate snapshot stamp and contextual spot marker appear.
scenes.joke: The snapshot stamp lands harder than the tiny spot marker expects.
scenes.narration: Calm can mean mean reversion. Tension can mean acceleration. Either way, levels are possibilities—not promises.

scenes.idea: Combine regime and walls with option flow.
scenes.action: Regime, wall map, and flow tape lock together; the exact TradingFlow logo and URL hold.
scenes.joke: The puck settles with a satisfied paper click.
scenes.narration: Weather. Map. Then the tape. Explore GEX in TradingFlow.
